title: Reference item matcher output (B.4): pairs of the same item across the two families' lists.
description: Ids are checked in code: each pair must hold one id from list A and one from list B, and each id pairs at most once.

pairs.description: One entry per pair of items that are the same item. Empty when none match.

a.description: An id from LIST A, exactly as given

b.description: An id from LIST B, exactly as given
